---
> **Disclaimer:** This mod was created as both a personal endeavor and an experiment in AI-assisted development and community feedback. Due to the use of AI in coding, bugs, errors, or imperfect implementations may be present. Kindly report any issues encountered.
---
Forgotten Diversions - a mod that adds a structure featuring simple arcade games. 

Inside:
- Minesweeper - find all the bombs, just try not to do it with your face.
- Light Game - simply repeat the sequence of flashing symbols.
- Math - solve simple equations, where the answer is always greater than 0.
(Yeah, I copied a mini-game from VOTV, what are you gonna do about it?)
- That's it for now... BUT MORE TO COME!

Need to find everything? Use a map! 
You can find them in the usual spots: dungeon chests or by trading with a Cartographer

![map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af9153e3fa875e263690f82d3da557a3a82d67bc_0.webp)
